sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for missing values
print('\nMissing values:\n', sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for duplicates
print('\nDuplicate rows:', sales_df.duplicated().sum())

# Check value counts for channel and status

print('\nStatus value counts:\n', sales_df['status'].value_counts())"}
